datasets.name: APMC Monthly Commodity Prices and Arrivals
datasets.source: Government of India / AGMARKNET / Maharashtra Dept. of Agriculture
datasets.intended_use: Market demand gap, modal price benchmarking, seasonal price indexing for agricultural enterprises
datasets.known_limitations: Historical benchmark dataset; requires seasonal adjustment index for current year

datasets.name: Government of India Minimum Support Prices (MSP)
datasets.source: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) / Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES)
datasets.organization: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoAFW)
datasets.intended_use: Floor price security, crop risk assessment, minimum revenue guarantee calculation
datasets.known_limitations: Only covers notified MSP crops (cereals, pulses, oilseeds)

datasets.name: ICAR Soil & Climate Agronomic Crop Suitability
datasets.source: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) & State Agricultural Universities
datasets.time_period: Multi-year experimental & agronomic field trial records
datasets.units: N, P, K: kg/ha, Temperature: °C, Humidity: %, pH: 0-14, Rainfall: mm
datasets.intended_use: Agronomic feasibility classifier for micro-entrepreneurs selecting agricultural ventures
datasets.known_limitations: Experimental trial data; real-world yields vary with farm management

datasets.name: District-wise Crop Production and Yield Statistics
datasets.source: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Ministry of Agriculture
datasets.organization: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoAFW)
datasets.units: Area: Hectares, Production: Tonnes, Yield: Tonnes/Hectare, Rainfall: mm
datasets.intended_use: Yield prediction regression model, land-to-production capacity ratios
datasets.known_limitations: Rainfed vs irrigated differences aggregated at district level

datasets.name: State-wise Cost of Cultivation and Operational Costs
datasets.source: Comprehensive Scheme for Cost of Cultivation of Principal Crops, DES
datasets.organization: Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), MoAFW
datasets.time_period: Published Agricultural Statistics at a Glance
datasets.intended_use: Direct operational cost benchmarking for seed, labor, fertilizer, and irrigation per unit area
datasets.known_limitations: State averages; local input costs may fluctuate

datasets.name: State-Level Modal Market Prices for Cash Crops and Agro Products
datasets.source: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection (DMI) / AGMARKNET
datasets.organization: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
datasets.intended_use: Benchmark selling price for farmgate and local processing revenues
datasets.known_limitations: Wholesale mandi prices; retail farmgate price requires 10-15% retail margin adjustment

datasets.name: NABARD Model Bankable Project Standards (Dairy, Poultry, Agro-Processing)
datasets.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
datasets.units: INR, Daily Yield (L), Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR), Months
datasets.intended_use: Deterministic techno-economic modeling of micro-enterprises without inventing synthetic rows

datasets.name: Central & State Government Schemes & Subsidies Database
datasets.source: Ministry of MSME, MoFPI, DAHD, Ministry of Finance
datasets.intended_use: Subsidy eligibility, interest subvention calculation, and scheme routing
